description: This file implements the SharedStorageImplementation class, which manages shared storage operations, notifications, and interactions with persistent store interfaces within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes methods for configuration, notification registration, value management, and storage size handling.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing shared storage operations, notifications, and interactions with persistent store interfaces.

methods.name: SharedStorageImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and setting up logging.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Cleans up resources, releases interfaces, and logs destruction.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton-like method to get or set the static instance of SharedStorageImplementation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback if not already registered.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback if found.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the object with a given service, queries interfaces, and establishes communication channels.

methods.name: getRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Returns the appropriate remote store interface based on scope.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Dispatches a value changed event to registered notifications.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Submits an event job to the worker pool.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes registered notifications with value change details.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the shared storage for a given scope, namespace, and key.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL from shared storage for a given scope, namespace, and key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from shared storage.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves keys within a namespace for device scope.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespaces for device scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage size information for device scope.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace within device scope.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace within device scope.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes the cache of the shared storage.
